name: webgrip-infrastructure-release-toolchain
description: Locked release toolchain for every image train in this repo — NOT a publishable package. Installed by .forgejo/actions/semantic-release-monorepo via `npm ci` at the repo root, so ops/docker/<image>/.releaserc.cjs resolves one deterministic tree (semantic-release-monorepo's documented root-install mode). The `overrides` block mirrors @webgrip/semantic-release-config's own, verbatim: it is the only npm mechanism that can force the notes-toolchain pair chosen in semantic-release-config PR #10 (generator 15.0.0-beta.2 / analyzer 14.0.0-beta.3 sit outside semantic-release's ^14/^13 ranges, so any manifest-less install nests stable copies under semantic-release and its plugin loader picks those up — measured in runs 426-435, empty release notes). Keep the overrides in lockstep with the config's package.json when either moves.
